set.body: Found during C2 (provenance v2) readiness. ObservedFamilyAdmission.geometry embeds onsets, TR, precision, whitening, nuisance as raw Double toString; ProfileHrfFit 'profile-fit/v2' embeds decode=${policy.budget} (default toString), lambda, grid, config. JVM renders 24.0 vs JS 24, so these strings differ across platforms. In-process only today (each platform self-consistent). Fix: move to the HrfIdentity encoding (bits:, length-prefixed, tagged records, decode-budget/v1) with a version bump and shared JVM+JS goldens, as C2 did for kernel-basis/condition-profile.
set.title: ObservedFamilyAdmission.geometry and profile-fit/v2 interpolate Doubles (JVM/JS identity drift)
